title: Regulatory Corpus Entry
description: Schema for a single entry in the FIU-IND AML regulatory knowledge corpus

id.description: Unique rule ID. Format: {CATEGORY_PREFIX}-{NNN}. E.g. STR-001, RFI-007.

rule.description: The regulatory fact/rule stated as precisely as the source allows.

document.description: Full document name + section. E.g. 'PMLA 2002, Section 12(1)(b)'

url.description: URL to the source. Never invented — use best-known URL.

url_verified.description: true only when manually confirmed live and pointing to the right document.

accessed_date.description: ISO 8601 date. Null = not yet accessed.

effective_date.description: ISO 8601 date the rule came into force. Null if unknown — do NOT guess.

evidence_level.description: Claim-audit tag. NEEDS-VERIFICATION entries must not appear in generated output.

my_synthesis.description: PO-lens interpretation. Not a source. Distinct from rule.

last_verified.description: ISO 8601 date last checked against primary source. Null = never verified.

snapshot_date.description: ISO 8601 'as of' date for this entry.

gap_notes.description: Open questions or verification tasks specific to this entry.

source_authority.description: Authority type of the PRIMARY source. PRODUCT_COMPILED = no single primary authority (e.g. POE-001, DG-19).

corpus_version.description: Corpus release containing this rule; must equal manifest.yaml corpus_version.

review_status.description: VERIFIED requires last_verified AND verified_by. DRAFT = NEEDS-VERIFICATION. Nothing is VERIFIED by default.

verified_by.description: Reviewer who re-checked the live primary source. Null until verified. `last_verified` is the verified date.

superseded_by.description: Rule ID or instrument that replaces this rule. Non-null => never shown as current.

replaces.description: Instrument/mechanism this rule replaces (e.g. STR-006 replaces the FINnet direct-upload mechanism).

regulatory_perimeter.description: Which regulated entities the rule does / does not apply to (e.g. SB-004 excludes SEBI/IRDAI entities).

last_reviewed.description: ISO 8601 date the owner last REVIEWED this rule (distinct from last_verified, which is an independent re-check against the live primary source). Null = never reviewed.

review_sla_days.description: Days allowed between reviews. Null = the corpus policy default (manifest review_policy.max_review_age_days).

approval_status.description: APPROVED requires approved_by and approved_on; otherwise the rule is treated as UNAPPROVED. Approval never lifts the NEEDS-VERIFICATION or superseded exclusion.

approved_by.description: Person who approved the rule for use. Null until someone does.
